hypothesis: The M161 current zero-relvel boundary outcome-critical rows should be converted into a reusable training-time corpus and objective before any guarded PPO continuation.
success_criteria: use only deployable P0 history features for student inputs
use M161 boundary relocation rows only as training-time supervision or gating artifacts
export a current zero-relvel boundary-outcome corpus with accepted wrong-history rows, paired normal/wrong outcomes, and diversity metadata
run objective-only sanity before actor updates or PPO
verify the objective improves boundary outcome preference or risk ranking without changing actor inputs
state whether a guarded candidate update is admitted
failure_criteria: feed relocated oracle labels or hidden parameters to the actor
train from duplicate-dominated rows without diversity metadata
claim driver-level self-identification from objective-only loss improvements

commands.name: m162_current_boundary_outcome_corpus_objective
commands.command: Build a reusable M161 boundary-outcome corpus and run objective-only sanity before any actor/PPO update.

decision_rule: Admit a guarded actor update only after objective-only sanity shows useful signal on the diversified M161 boundary-outcome corpus; do not admit PPO from corpus construction alone.
